intentEvidence: This plugin lets you render Pug templates in your Obsidian vault.
problem: Obsidian lacks native support for using powerful templating languages like Pug to structure and generate content within notes.

relations.evidence: If you have installed and enabled Dataview, then its API will be exposed to the Pug rendering context under the dv variable.

summary: A plugin that allows rendering Pug templates within Obsidian notes, using note properties (front matter) as the rendering context.
